newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's November lead output rises 5.3 percent.
newsitem.headline: Peru's November lead output rises 5.3 percent.

text.p: Peru's lead output rose 5.3 percent to 21,028 tonnes in November compared to the same month last year, according to preliminary figures from Energy and Mines Ministry released Friday.
Production rose 6.1 percent to 226,118 tonnes in the first 11 months of the year against the same period last year.
In 1995, lead output dipped 0.4 percent to 232,540 tonnes from 233,510 tonnes the previous year.
Peru is the world's number three lead producer. State-owned Centromin is the country's largest producer of the metal.
